module purpose: neorv32_cpu is the top-level CPU composition block that connects the frontend, control, counters, register file, ALU, LSU, and optional PMP and ICC sub-units. It forwards the instruction/data bus interfaces, assembles machine-interrupt and CSR-extension data, and computes the register-file write-back value used inside the CPU.

use-case flows.value: interrupt requests delivered to the control unit, including the locally assembled machine-interrupt vector
effective address from the ALU delivered to control, the load/store unit, and the PMP checker
register-file write-back data combined from ALU result, LSU read data, CSR read data, and return-PC data
extension CSR read data combined from ALU, counters, PMP, and ICC sources and delivered to the control unit
PMP fault indication reported to the control unit and LSU, or forced low when PMP is disabled
